spec_isomorphism_proof:
by
  intro impl
  constructor
  · -- problem_spec → generated_spec
    intro hp
    -- the first component is characterised by induction on the number of deleted characters
    have key : ∀ (n : Nat) (c : String), c.toList.length ≤ n → ∀ s : String,
        ((impl s c).1).toList = s.toList.filter (fun ch => !(c.toList.contains ch)) := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        intro c hlen s
        obtain ⟨⟨r1, r2⟩, hr, _, h2, _⟩ := hp s c
        have hc0 : c.toList.length = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hlen
        rw [hr]
        simp only
        rw [h2 hc0, List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero hc0]
        simp
      | succ n ih =>
        intro c hlen s
        obtain ⟨⟨r1, r2⟩, hr, _, h2, h3⟩ := hp s c
        rw [hr]
        simp only
        by_cases hc0 : c.toList.length = 0
        · rw [h2 hc0, List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero hc0]
          simp
        · have hpos : c.toList.length > 0 := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hc0
          obtain ⟨a, rest, hcl⟩ : ∃ a rest, c.toList = a :: rest := by
            match hm : c.toList with
            | [] => rw [hm] at hpos; simp at hpos
            | x :: xs => exact ⟨x, xs, rfl⟩
          have hlen' : ((c.drop 1).toString).toList.length ≤ n := by
            rw [iso_toList_drop_one, hcl]
            rw [hcl] at hlen
            simp at hlen ⊢
            omega
          have hIH := ih ((c.drop 1).toString) hlen'
            (String.join ((s.toList.filter (fun x => decide (x ≠ c.toList.head!))).map
              (fun ch => String.mk [ch])))
          rw [h3 hpos]
          simp only [iso_data_eq_toList]
          rw [hIH, iso_join_map_singleton, iso_toList_drop_one, hcl]
          simp only [List.head!_cons, List.drop_succ_cons, List.drop_zero]
          exact iso_filter_step a rest s.toList
    intro s c
    refine ⟨key c.toList.length c (le_refl _) s, ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨⟨r1, r2⟩, hr, h1, _, _⟩ := hp s c
    rw [hr]
    simp only at h1 ⊢
    exact (Iff.of_eq h1).trans List.Palindrome.iff_reverse_eq
  · -- generated_spec → problem_spec
    intro hg s c
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hg s c
    refine ⟨impl s c, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact propext (h2.trans List.Palindrome.iff_reverse_eq.symm)
    · intro hc
      have hc' : c.toList = [] := List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero hc
      apply String.ext
      rw [h1, hc']
      simp
    · intro hc
      have hc' : c.toList.length > 0 := hc
      obtain ⟨a, rest, hcl⟩ : ∃ a rest, c.toList = a :: rest := by
        match hm : c.toList with
        | [] => rw [hm] at hc'; simp at hc'
        | x :: xs => exact ⟨x, xs, rfl⟩
      apply String.ext
      simp only [iso_data_eq_toList]
      rw [h1, (hg (String.join ((s.toList.filter (fun x => decide (x ≠ c.toList.head!))).map
        (fun ch => String.mk [ch]))) ((c.drop 1).toString)).1,
        iso_join_map_singleton, iso_toList_drop_one, hcl]
      simp only [List.head!_cons, List.drop_succ_cons, List.drop_zero]
      exact (iso_filter_step a rest s.toList).symm
iso_helper_lemmas:
set_option linter.deprecated false

/-- `String.data` is the deprecated spelling of `String.toList`. -/
theorem iso_data_eq_toList (s : String) : s.data = s.toList := rfl

/-- The characters of a string obtained by joining single-character strings. -/
theorem iso_join_map_singleton (l : List Char) :
    (String.join (l.map (fun c => String.mk [c]))).toList = l := by
  have hmk : ∀ c : Char, (String.mk [c]).toList = [c] := fun c => String.toList_ofList
  simp only [String.toList_join, List.map_map, Function.comp_def, hmk]
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a t ih => simp [ih]

/-- Dropping the first character of a string drops the first character of its list. -/
theorem iso_toList_drop_one (s : String) :
    ((s.drop 1).toString).toList = s.toList.drop 1 := by
  by_cases hs : s = ""
  · subst hs; rfl
  · have h : s.startPos ≠ s.endPos := by
      simpa [String.startPos_eq_endPos_iff] using hs
    have hdrop : s.drop 1 = s.sliceFrom (s.startPos.next h) := by
      simp [String.drop, String.Slice.drop, String.Slice.Pos.nextn, String.sliceFrom,
        String.startPos_toSlice, String.Pos.toSlice_next, String.Pos.toSlice_inj, h]
    have hempty : (s.sliceTo s.startPos).copy = "" := by
      apply String.utf8ByteSize_eq_zero_iff.mp
      simp [String.Slice.utf8ByteSize_copy, String.endExclusive_sliceTo,
        String.startInclusive_sliceTo, String.offset_startPos]
    have key := String.Pos.eq_copy_sliceTo_append_get h
    rw [hempty] at key
    have hlist := congrArg String.toList key
    rw [String.toList_append, String.toList_append, String.toList_empty,
      String.toList_singleton] at hlist
    rw [hdrop]
    show ((s.sliceFrom (s.startPos.next h)).copy).toList = s.toList.drop 1
    rw [hlist]
    simp

/-- Deleting one character and then the rest is the same as deleting all of them at once. -/
theorem iso_filter_step (a : Char) (rest l : List Char) :
    (l.filter (fun x => decide (x ≠ a))).filter (fun ch => !(rest.contains ch))
      = l.filter (fun ch => !((a :: rest).contains ch)) := by
  rw [List.filter_filter]
  apply List.filter_congr
  intro x _
  simp [Bool.and_comm]
